# HZ Labs

> סטודיו פיתוח לבניית פלטפורמות תוכן, אינטגרציות AI ואוטומציות לארגונים — תל אביב, ישראל.

HZ Labs is a boutique software development studio based in Tel Aviv, Israel.
We design and build complex digital platforms and AI-powered automation systems
for organizations and businesses. Small team, personal approach, production-grade results.

## Services

### AI Integration & Automation
- AI automation workflows — intelligent pipelines that detect, classify, and act without manual intervention
- Reasoning agents — LLM-based decision engines that replace repetitive human judgment
- Smart analytics — dashboards that surface real-time insights from organizational data
- AI integrations with existing systems — CRM, email, forms, databases, APIs

### Platform Development
- Full-stack web platform development (design → production)
- Content & media platforms with video streaming, live events, and tiered access
- Customer portals and subscription systems
- Event management and membership systems
- API integrations between existing tools and systems
- Ongoing development support and iteration

## Who We Work With

Organizations and businesses that want to reduce manual work, move faster, and scale
without adding headcount. We work directly with founders and team leads — no layers,
no handoffs.

## Contact

- Website: https://harzahav.online
- Email: labs@har-zahav.com
- Location: Tel Aviv, Israel

## Technology

TypeScript, React, Node.js, Docker, nginx, LLMs (Claude, GPT), AI agents,
REST & GraphQL APIs, Auth systems, CMS integrations, Analytics pipelines.
